method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live from a europa.eu origin page, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. 16 of 18 candidates in this window returned HTTP 200 with exact title matches and were filled. Two postings returned HTTP 404 (dead postings) and were skipped without a fill: 2c5ac3a14dddacd4 (DE, Lagerhelfer (m/w/d) (Helfer/in - Lagerwirtschaft, Transport)); 2d0d9646011a4201 (EE, Perevanem) - the dead-link sweep owns pruning. Also includes the re-review of 10f3a8957deaaac2 after its Nov22 identity drift (new posting under the same dedup key): the current posting was verified live and its fill updated in place with a source_id pin, per the reviewed_fills expected_source_id guard shipped the same day.
